propositions: Gates miss defects when evidence is collected outside the repository without recording the measurement context (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument type)
Operator-attested evidence currently lacks deterministic enforcement of measurement provenance fields, allowing unsupported claims to pass review

Policy simulators and live API calls produce structurally different evidence classes but are indistinguishable in attestations, enabling wrong conclusions (e.g. simulate-principal-policy returning incorrect authorization when instrument-kind mattered)

Plans asserting unchanged behaviour across substrate/provider/route swaps without citing the code paths that consume the swapped configuration remain invisible to review despite being fully repo-checkable
Evidence quality depends on whether an observation could have come out the other way for the reason it was being tested, not just on whether ground truth is reachable

Measurement provenance must be captured as human-writable, repo-checkable text fields (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) enforced deterministically without LLM, then judged by LLM criteria over recorded declarations against IaC and code facts
